profile.headline: Software Engineer - Special Projects Manager at Learning Evolution, LLC
profile.summary: Curious and enthusiastic developer innovating with desktop, mobile, web and VR applications. Proven vision and collaborative leadership skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Special Projects Manager
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Technical Program Manager
positions.description:
• Developed SaaS called "Opus" that efficiently manages students, instructors and administrators of several hundred educational companies.
• Managed team of three software engineers to implement new business features like lead generation and tracking.
• Redesigned decade-old site with modern UI / UX (~2,000 lines of CSS).
• Utilized PHP, MySQL, Zend Framework, jQuery, Ajax, HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Project Manager & Developer – The Aquatic Messenger
positions.description:
• Supervised the design and development of touchscreen and VR builds.
• Collaborated with Echo Museum of Vermont to design and install a touchscreen exhibit for 150,000+ annual visitors.
• Ran demo exhibits at the Center for Holographic Arts, Governor’s Island, NYC; the Climate Reality Summit at Lake George, N.Y.; and Jump into the Light VR/AR venue in downtown NYC. Collected and addressed user feedback.
• Trained and directed team of 12 (incl. programmers, artists and scientists).
• Partnered with the Jefferson Project and Darrin Fresh Water Institute.
• Programmed with C# in Unity 3D and composed soundtrack in Logic Pro.

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Four-summer internship through the Emma Bowen Foundation.
• Wrote software in Java integrated with Stratus to transcribe dialogue of videos before airing live. Reduced overall human transcription time by 63%.
• Made C# Windows service to track XML weather feeds and push to live news.
• Developed dynamic weather feeds site using PHP, MySQL and Ajax.
• Launched station-wide digital filing system on Linux server to facilitate documentation and minimize paper consumption. Digitized 1,000+ IT records.
• Deployed digital management system and inventoried all IT equipment.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description: Compete against players across the globe, earn rewards and advance in the leaderboards. Challenge your friends to real-time fights in the arena.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: • Redesigned employee Intranet website using Sitefinity's content management system.

company.name: Family Health Centers of San Diego

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science / Games and Simulation Arts and Sciences

projects.title: Gattic (Stock Market Trading Platform)
projects.description:
• In team of six software engineers coding an intelligent, fast and scalable C++ trading platform.
• Designed frontend application framework with SDL2 to aid the technical analysis of trading strategies.
• Made GUI components: buttons, labels, text boxes, list boxes, dropdowns, realtime graphing, linear & relative layouts, and window panels.
• Developed Java Android app to leverage Gattic platform for event scheduling.

projects.title: Terrium (Online Video Game)
projects.description:
• Created 3D sci-fi game with networked vehicular combat and world creation.
• Directed three programmers, two artists and one music / sound composer.
• Programmed gameplay and UI with C# in Unity 3D.
• Leveraged Node.js (Express framework) and MongoDB to create a fast and scalable backend for user account and world content management.
